description: Fail-closed scan for a Mancers-gated Robinhood (4663) NFT mint. Requires bytecode that references Mancers 0x797a…, value=0, a sim with Transfer to the minter and no setApprovalForAll. Never returns safe. executeFire needs actionMode=execute, ORACLE_AUTONOMOUS_MINT=1, and a grant naming this exact contract with maxValueWei=0. Trading flag does not unlock mint. Returns unsigned mint + revoke calldata — never signs.
name: nft_mancer_os_scan
